responsibility: Prepare a proportionate work plan with outcomes, steps, dependencies and acceptance evidence. Use to plan substantial work or coordinate an approved team; a plan-only request does not authorize implementation.
inputs: Supplied task and selected source scope; exact destination only for requested persistence or application work. Load project context only when the task needs project records.

modes.when: When reading project-bound planning context, resolve the actual context with native reads; compose with file-read for source files.
